title: A linear-in-$q$ range of dimensions for the MDS conjecture over $\mathbb F_q$ in odd characteristic
summary: Let $q$ be a power of an odd prime $p$. We prove the MDS conjecture over $\mathbb F_q$ in every dimension $k$ satisfying \[ 2\leqslant k\leqslant B(p,q) \quad\text{or}\quad q+2-B(p,q)\leqslant k\leqslant q, \qquad B(p,q)=\left\lfloor\frac{(p-2)q+6p-10}{2p-3}\right\rfloor. \] For fixed $p$, the first interval is linear in $q$; together with duality, the theorem covers an asymptotic proportion $1-1/(2p-3)$ of all dimensions.
